messages.content: Tell me some of the major airports in the United States.

function.name: distance_calculate
function.description: Calculate the distance between two geographical points. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

from_lat.description: The latitude of the start point. This is a float type value.

from_long.description: The longitude of the start point. This is a float type value.

to_lat.description: The latitude of the end point. This is a float type value.

message.content:
Here are some of the major airports in the United States, ranked by passenger traffic and importance as international hubs:

| Airport | City / State | IATA Code | Notable Features |
|---------|--------------|-----------|------------------|
| Hartsfield‑Jackson Atlanta International Airport (ATL) | Atlanta, GA | ATL | Largest airport in the world by passenger traffic; major hub for Delta Air Lines. |
| Los Angeles International Airport (LAX) | Los Angeles, CA | LAX | Major gateway to Asia and Latin America; home to many international carriers. |
| Chicago O’Hare International Airport (ORD) | Chicago, IL | ORD | One of the busiest airports in the U.S.; major hub for United Airlines and American Airlines. |
| Dallas/Fort Worth International Airport (DFW) | Dallas–Fort Worth, TX | DFW | Large hub for American Airlines; extensive domestic network. |
| Denver International Airport (DEN) | Denver, CO | DEN | Known for its distinctive peaked roof; hub for United Airlines and Southwest Airlines. |
| John F. Kennedy International Airport (JFK) | New York City, NY | JFK | Major international gateway; hub for JetBlue, Delta, and American Airlines. |
| San Francisco International Airport (SFO) | San Francisco, CA | SFO | Key hub for flights to Asia and Europe; known for its efficient operations. |
| Seattle–Tacoma International Airport (SEA) | Seattle, WA | SEA | Hub for Alaska Airlines and a growing presence for other carriers. |
| Miami International Airport (MIA) | Miami, FL | MIA | Major hub for flights to Latin America and the Caribbean. |
| Orlando International Airport (MCO) | Orlando, FL | MCO | Popular destination for tourists heading to Disney World and Universal Studios. |

These airports serve as critical nodes in both domestic and international air travel networks across the United States.
